package.name: field_hospital_simulation
package.description: Gazebo Sim (Fortress) simulation of an outbreak field hospital for testing the risk_maps risk-aware navigation stack. Provides a wheelchair robot model, a generated field-hospital world, and ground-truth perception nodes that stand in for SegFormer (terrain) and RTAB-Map (obstacles) so the elevation / fusion / global / local pipeline runs unmodified in sim.
